properties.description:
SVRPSR

The National Weather Service in Phoenix has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Gila County in east central Arizona...

* Until 300 PM MST.

Sawmill, or 41 miles east of Globe, moving north at 35 mph.

HAZARD...Ping pong ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect
wind damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Mainly rural areas of Gila County.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds and large
hail.

Continuous cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Lightning is one of nature's leading killers. Remember, if you can
hear thunder, you are close enough to be struck by lightning.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

A Tornado Watch remains in effect until 800 PM MST Thursday for a
portion of east central Arizona.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 22 at 1:56PM MST until October 23 at 12:00AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Moenkopi Wash and the Little Colorado River from Cameron to
the Colorado River confluence.

* WHEN...Until midnight MST /100 AM MDT/ Tonight.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of creeks and normally dry washes is imminent or
occurring. Further rises in the water levels of already flooded
creeks and normally dry washes. Deadly flooding over low-water
crossings.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 148 PM MST /248 PM MDT/, The river gauge on Moenkopi Wash
remains above flood stage, and additional rainfall today will
keep levels elevated into tonight. High flows continue along the
Little Colorado River from the confluence with the Moenkopi Wash
to the Colorado River.
- This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Hamblin Wash, Begashibito Wash, Little Colorado River, Moenkopi
Wash, Bekihatso Wash, Fivemile Wash and Sheep Wash.

Flooding is occurring along Moenkopi Wash.
- For Moenkopi Wash at Moenkopi Wash Near Tuba City: Moenkopi Wash
remains at major flood stage, and is forecast to drop below flood
stage by around midnight MDT tonight. Some locations that will
experience flooding include...  Tuba City, Moenkopi, Little
Colorado River Navajo Tribal Park and Salt Trail Canyon. - This
includes the following recreation areas andcampgrounds...
Blue Water Base Camp and Old Fish Camp Site.

This includes the following swimming holes...
Blue Water Base Camp.
- Additional information is available at weather.gov/flagstaff.
properties.instruction:
Stay away or be swept away! The banks of creeks and washes are
unstable and unsafe during any flooding event.

properties.description:

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

Yavapai County in west central Arizona...

the region have caused a nearly 4 foot rise in Wet Beaver Creek.

flash flooding.

Crossing/The Crack and Wet Beaver Wilderness.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Watch issued October 22 at 2:42PM MDT until October 23 at 12:00PM MDT by NWS Boise ID
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flash flooding and debris flows caused by excessive rainfall
are possible over the Crooked burn scar and Wapiti burn scar. Total
rainfall up to 1 inch is possible on the burn scars.

* WHERE...Wapiti and Crooked burn scars in southwest Idaho including
Highway 21 between Grandjean and Banner Summit.

* WHEN...From 6 PM MDT this evening through Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...Heavy rainfall over the Crooked and Wapiti burn scars
which could trigger flash flooding or debris flows. Residents near
the Crooked and Wapiti burn scar should prepare for potential
debris flow. Mud and debris could impact Highway 21 between
Grandjean and Banner Summit.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- National Weather Service Meteorologists are forecasting heavy
rainfall over the Crooked and Wapiti burn scar, which may lead to
flash flooding and debris flows.
- Some locations that may experience flash flooding include...
Grandjean and Highway 21 between Grandjean and Banner Summit.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
You should monitor later forecasts and be prepared to take action
should Flash Flood Warnings be issued.
